title: Require Map Mod Project Root Topology
forbids: workspace map-mod definitions without their package, Nx project, source spine, closed pure-authoring interior, and exact target proof; or loose definition-root children outside the finite project topology
why: A reusable map-mod definition is one constructible plugin project with authored source and one closed pure-authoring face for configuration admission, serialization, and finite metadata targets. The released Habitat app blueprint independently owns realization roots; this local definition law does not copy or weaken it.
remediate: Keep package.json, project.json, src, authoring/config.ts, authoring/index.ts, authoring/targets.ts, and test/authoring/targets.test.ts in each map-mod definition. Keep host filesystem effects outside authoring, place transitional tools under scripts, behavior proof under test, generated output under dist, and remove or relocate every other root child.
message: Workspace map-mod definitions must match the closed definition and authoring topology.
